text: S637 tests a new, measured CLO mark-geometry hypothesis only: the S629 Woven CIRCLE→12-point-polyline output exceeds 0.001 cm by 0.005113 cm sagitta. Query native full-circle/CUT/SEW geometry and inspect detailed rendered marks; no export unless all applicable pre-export gates pass.
